scope: All UTM undergraduate international catalogue rows, including current-cycle not-open rows.

policy.duration: No default undergraduate duration is allowed. Programme duration must come from official programme detail or official supplemental handbook evidence. Semester-based duration is standardized as semesters / 2 years for public display.
policy.fee: Rows marked current-cycle-not-open remain public-visible and must still carry official international undergraduate total tuition. No not-applicable-for-international fee display is allowed.
